title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.42.0)
author: Ava Nguyen
description:
Motivation: customers reported inconsistent retry behavior and ergonomics across our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, especially around auth refresh and streaming clients. This PR unifies the auth + retry strategies, improves streaming ergonomics (consistent async iterator/event APIs), and applies parity fixes and version bumps across all SDKs.

What changed: unified retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, idempotency-aware retries), centralized auth refresh logic and token caching, streaming API surface aligned between languages, small bugfixes to header propagation and cancelation behavior, and package version bumps to v1.42.0 across Python/TS/Go. Includes updated docs and end-to-end tests.

Checklist:
- [x] Unify retry configuration and defaults across SDKs
- [x] Centralize token refresh logic and shared semantics
- [x] Streaming API ergonomic improvements (async iterator + event emitter parity)
- [x] Add cross-language integration tests
- [x] Update changelogs and bump versions to v1.42.0

Notes: Kept backwards-compatible defaults where possible; breaking changes documented in release notes when unavoidable (small rename of internal helper only). CI required a rerun of flaky integration tests; final CI is green.

Related: Linear ENG-2981, ENG-3012, PM-45.
